passive.name: Ravenous Flock
passive.description: Swain's ravens collect Soul Fragments that heal him and permanently increase his maximum health.

spells.name: Death's Hand
spells.description: Swain unleashes 5 eldritch bolts, dealing magic damage plus magic damage per bolt past the first (max magic damage).

spells.name: Vision of Empire
spells.description: Swain opens a demon eye, revealing a location for 1.5 seconds, then deals magic damage and Slows by % for seconds. Champions hit grant Swain a Soul Fragment and are revealed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Nevermove
spells.description: Swain launches a wave of demonic power that returns, detonating on the first enemy hit to deal magic damage and Root enemies in the area for seconds. Rooting a champion allows Swain to reactivate this ability to pull all champions Rooted by Nevermove toward him, gaining a Soul Fragment for each.
